Which age group are you in?

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Hi! Welcome to SETU. I can help you discover government schemes or get support with an issue. Which language would you like to continue in?
excel_steps.Notes: Welcome and language selection merged into one step. Confirm supported languages and translations for every BOT message.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): What would you like to explore today?
excel_steps.Option Label: Individual Schemes | Family Schemes | I need help
excel_steps.Notes: Individual Schemes starts Flow 1. Family Schemes routes to Flow 2. 'I need help' bypasses demographics and goes directly to CRM ticket creation.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): You’ve chosen Individual Schemes. I’ll ask a few short questions so I can show schemes that may be relevant to you.
Which state do you currently live in?
excel_steps.Notes: State selection. BOT is intended for citizens of India, so a separate citizenship question is not required.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which age group are you in?
excel_steps.Notes: District collection removed from scheme discovery. Exact location should be captured only at CRM ticket creation stage.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): What best describes your current occupation?
excel_steps.Option Label: Farmer | Labourer | Salaried | Self-employed | Student | Unemployed | Homemaker | Retired | Other
excel_steps.Notes: Final occupation taxonomy to be confirmed.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which range best describes your total monthly household income?
excel_steps.Notes: Income bands should be validated against the scheme eligibility engine and may need annual-income equivalents.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which social category would you like to select?
excel_steps.Notes: Caste / social-category options updated for scheme eligibility: SC, ST, OBC, General, Minority.

excel_steps.Option Label: Single | Married | Widowed | Divorced / Separated | Prefer not to say
Yes | No | Prefer not to say
excel_steps.Notes: Disability percentage is not collected. BOT captures only disability status at this stage.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Here’s what I have so far. Please check your details before I look for matching schemes.
Based on the information you shared, here are the schemes that may be relevant to you. Choose one to learn more.
excel_steps.Notes: Eligibility logic and ranking rules are required. Results should explain that final eligibility depends on official scheme verification.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which scheme would you like to explore?
excel_steps.Notes: Allow the user to return to the eligible-scheme list without re-entering profile information.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Here are the key details for this scheme: benefits, who can apply, documents you may need, how to apply, and useful links or contacts. What would you like to do next?
excel_steps.Option Label: I need help | View other schemes

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Would you like to go back to the main menu or end this chat?
excel_steps.Notes: If End Chat is selected, proceed to feedback before closing.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Before you go, how would you rate your experience with SETU today?
excel_steps.Notes: Referral prompt must only be shown for ratings 3, 4 or 5. Ratings 1 or 2 should close without a referral ask.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Thanks for the feedback. If SETU was useful, would you like to share it with someone who may also benefit?
excel_steps.Notes: Referral step is shown after positive feedback only. Share mechanism/link to be confirmed.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): I can help with that. Please tell me briefly what you need support with, and I’ll create a support request for the SETU team.
excel_steps.Notes: Help/support bypasses all demographic questions. At ticket creation, collect only the information required to resolve the issue, including exact location where necessary.
